title: R and l, shi, and the weak h
subtitle: ㄹ ・ 시 ・ ㅎ
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. No audio yet: the Korean voice is not chosen.
intro: Three sounds that do not behave as their English letters suggest. Listen first, then copy the voice.

groups.title: One letter, two sounds: r and l
notes: Between vowels ㄹ is one light tap of the tongue, between an English r, l and d. At the end of a syllable it is l, and a double ㄹㄹ is a long l.

groups.title: si is said shi
notes: Before i and the y-vowels, ㅅ sounds like sh. The romanization still writes s.

groups.title: The h that almost disappears
notes: Between voiced sounds h is very weak, and many speakers hardly say it at all.

words.en: it is good: the h is written but not said
